Name: Redwood Furniture
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
[b]Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]25 new furniture items
[*]At least one of each type of furniture
[*]All done in redwood and black, very classy
[*]Shocking amount of sittable things (tables, chairs, paintings)
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]When placing a window or a lamp, a yellow or white light respectively will be at the top left corner of your house rather than where it should be. Upon waking up the next day this should be fixed.
[/list]
[b]Warning:[/b]
[list]
[*]This is a mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]CF[/url]﻿ by platonymous! You will have to have that downloaded in order for this to work!
[*]This adds furniture to your game rather than changing existing furniture, so you will have to buy it
[/list][b]
Thank you:[/b]
[list]
[*]To platonymous for this wonderful mod, to the ever-so-helpful folks over on the Stardew Valley Discord, and to anyone who left encouragement, suggestions, or endorsements on my other mod
[/list]
I told myself that I was going to put another mod out once I reached 100 unique downloads on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3121]Witch Furniture[/url]﻿, but it happened so fast! I shouldn't be too late, but I'm thrilled that people liked my mod! 

If you have any suggestions for furniture that you want to see in the game let me know! To those that did let me know, rest assured that I am indeed working on those, I just wanted to get this quick little mod out first.
